evaluation_protocol: Run the unchanged manifest against the lexical control, tree-sitter-swift 0.7.2, and tree-sitter-swift 0.7.3 at one exact OpenClaw revision. Every arm uses a fresh database and the same 1024 source-token budget per task. A Swift candidate is eligible only if relevant-file recall improves by at least one of 20 labeled files or line-anchor recall improves by at least five percentage points, with no task-family relevant-file regression. It must not increase incomplete files relative to the other Swift candidate, regress existing product tests, exceed 10% cold-index or peak-RSS growth, exceed 5% database growth, or add more than 5 MiB to the release binary. Timing and memory thresholds require paired same-host runs and are interpreted as diagnostics on this ten-task development set, not universal performance claims.
reclassification_rule: The task labels and thresholds remain fixed for every arm. Any task, label, query, token budget, corpus revision, parser query, or threshold change creates a new schema/report version. This consumed development set must not later be described as blind or statistically powered evidence.
manifest_description: Prospective Swift structural-indexing evaluation over OpenClaw iOS, macOS, and shared application owners. Prompts and labels were frozen from issue #366 and source inspection at the pinned revision before either grammar candidate was integrated.

methodology.oracle_baseline: Full contents of fix-labeled relevant files, as if an agent chose every file perfectly and paid no discovery cost.
methodology.rg_discovery_baseline: Bounded, path-sorted ripgrep --json output for fixed-string queries derived from each public bug task.
methodology.scripted_baseline: One JSON envelope containing the ripgrep discovery output and oracle full-file reads.
methodology.source_tokens: Tokens in source content only; excludes paths, scores, reasons, receipts, and JSON syntax.
methodology.serialized_tokens: Tokens in the complete serialized JSON payload, including metadata and syntax.

corpora.name: openclaw-swift
corpora.prompt_provenance: Maintenance prompts were written from issue #366's named application owners and public declarations at the pinned OpenClaw revision before either Swift grammar arm ran; no future patch or fix commit was consulted.
corpora.label_provenance: Relevant files and one-based line anchors were selected from declaration, caller, and regression-test ownership at the pinned OpenClaw revision before either Swift grammar arm ran.
external_limitations: The ten tasks are manually curated parser-development evidence, not a random or statistically powered sample.
Line anchors identify declaration and test neighborhoods; they do not prove that every returned line is sufficient to implement a correct patch.
Prompts name public symbols to stress structural ownership and do not simulate an autonomous issue-triage trajectory.

tasks.prompt: Change GatewayEndpointID service-name canonicalization in stableID while preserving the non-service fallback, and update its regression tests.
Change ExecApprovalsSQLiteStore immediate-transaction fencing and TypeScript-compatible projection normalization, with store regression coverage.
Update LiveActivityPresentationArbiter tool precedence so ending the newest tool resumes the previous tool within the same session, and update the arbiter tests.
Change GatewayConnectionController ManualAuthOverride persisted and current-input behavior together with legacy device-auth migration, and update controller tests.
Update VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync to apply valid voice-wake change events and ignore invalid payloads, with synchronized tests.
Change GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport transport selection for directly reachable Tailscale and LAN gateways without reusing a stale SSH tunnel port, and update tests.
Change OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL validation to reject unsupported surface shapes while preserving valid v0.8 message decoding, and update tests.
Change ShareToAgentDeepLink message and URL construction so shared fields and optional instructions are cleaned and encoded consistently, with tests.
Change TalkConfigParsing provider selection and speech-recognition locale fallback while preserving normalized payload rules, and update contract tests.
Change OpenClawChatGatewayPayloadCodec session-routing identity decoding and event-frame mapping while preserving shared transport contracts, and update tests.

limitations: The oracle baseline assumes perfect file selection and reads whole files rather than exact decisive ranges.
The scripted ripgrep baseline uses fixed queries supplied by the manifest and is not an autonomous agent trajectory.
No model executes an edit, so this runner does not measure pass rate, prewalk handoff quality, or end-to-end task cost.
Cold indexing and warm latency depend on host hardware and filesystem cache state.
Validation prompts and labels were frozen from open issue reports and pinned source inspection, then used during retrieval tuning; this is not blind holdout evidence.
The validation tasks are retrieval development evidence, not a statistically powered product claim.
